    m=re.search(r'(\d{4})-(\d{2})', subj)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse year-month from subject: {subj} (thread {tid})")
    year=m.group(1)
    month=m.group(2)
    # file name should be MM-YYYY.pdf
    month_year=f"{month}-{year}"
    # pick PDF attachments (likely one)
    attachment_ids=[]
    for e in th.get('emails',[]):
        for a in e.get('attachments',[]):
            if (a.get('file_name','') or '').lower().endswith('.pdf'):
                attachment_ids.append((a['id'], a['file_name']))
    print('thread', tid, 'subject', subj, 'month_year', month_year, 'pdf_attachments', attachment_ids)
